name: manual_dd57c3
claim: When the failure a test expects shares a status code with a transport error, the status proves nothing: observe the production function that must receive the upstream reply and assert it was called. Prove the new assertion with a mutation that fails at that assertion itself; a mutation that trips an earlier assertion shows nothing about the new one.

decisions.notes: A drain test accepted status=502 for both a reply without usage and a transport failure. orama-system fb28125e asserts the 200 reply reached _settle_chat; the first mutation tried failed an earlier assertion and was redone as fetch-then-fail.
